dimensions.name: Concentration Transparency
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No concentration. 3: 'High potency'. 5: Percentage stated. 7: Percentage with why that level is optimal. 10: Percentage with efficacy data and concentration vs irritation tradeoff explained.

dimensions.name: Pore-Minimizing Claims
dimensions.description: Are pore-minimizing, oil-control, and sebum-regulation claims specific?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No claims. 3: Generic 'pore care'. 5: 'Minimizes pores'. 7: Specific mechanism (sebum regulation). 10: Clinical pore reduction data with visible results timeline.

dimensions.name: Oil Control Positioning
dimensions.description: Is oil-control, mattifying, or shine-reduction benefit communicated?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No mention. 5: 'Controls oil'. 10: Specific oil-control duration with mechanism and oily-skin suitability.

dimensions.name: Ingredient Pairing Guidance
dimensions.description: Is guidance on what to pair with (HA, zinc) and avoid (vitamin C at same time) provided?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No guidance. 3: One pairing. 5: Compatible ingredients listed. 7: Pairings + conflicts noted. 10: Full pairing guide with layering order and timing.

dimensions.name: Multi-Benefit Positioning
dimensions.description: Are multiple benefits communicated (barrier repair, brightening, anti-aging, anti-acne)?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: One benefit only. 3: 2 benefits. 5: 3 benefits. 7: 4+ benefits with specifics. 10: Comprehensive multi-benefit positioning with which benefit matters for which concern.

dimensions.name: Skin Type Targeting
dimensions.description: Is suitability for specific skin types clearly communicated?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No targeting. 5: 'All skin types'. 10: Specific type guidance with special suitability for oily/combo skin.

dimensions.name: Texture & Sensory
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No description. 5: Basic texture. 10: Full sensory profile with absorption and finish.

dimensions.name: Certifications
dimensions.description: Are vegan, cruelty-free, fragrance-free, non-comedogenic stated?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: None stated. 3: 1 certification or free-from claim. 5: 2-3 stated. 7: Comprehensive 'free-from' list covering fragrance, parabens and common irritants. 10: Full certification suite with cruelty-free + vegan + non-comedogenic confirmation.

dimensions.name: Clinical Backing
dimensions.description: Is dermatologist-tested or clinically studied referenced?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: None. 5: Basic claim. 10: Specific clinical evidence.
